confirmedProductionGaps.finding: Current client accepts an explicitly configured numeric endpoint and implements strict Direct Lockdown only. It has no RemotePairing/CDTunnel/RSD provider branch.
confirmedProductionGaps.nextConcreteProof: A read-only request through the actual authenticated same-device route must identify its protocol and return an authenticated installation Lookup; TCP-open or synthetic peers are insufficient.

confirmedProductionGaps.finding: Current StartService requires EnableServiceSSL=true. Both checked upstream clients also handle false/missing. This is a supported-subset gap, not evidence of what the user device returned.
confirmedProductionGaps.constraint: Do not delete TLS/authentication guards without binding the alternative to an authenticated provider/tunnel.

confirmedProductionGaps.finding: Current account client requires previously registered App IDs and contains no complete device/App ID/App Group registration flow. Initial computer provisioning may satisfy some prerequisites, which must be checked explicitly.
Refresh creates a new CSR and deliberately avoids revocation. Certificate reuse and quota-aware continuous renewal are not established.

claimAssessment.claim: iOS makes every form of in-app signing/self-refresh fundamentally impossible
claimAssessment.correction: Creating and signing a separate IPA in the app sandbox differs from modifying the installed executable. Conditional self-refresh exists; installation permission/routing is the decisive separate prerequisite.

claimAssessment.claim: free Apple certificate is always valid for seven days
claimAssessment.correction: Apple documents seven-day Personal Team provisioning profiles; certificate, profile, signed artifact and installed entitlement validation are distinct.

claimAssessment.claim: remote anisette makes AltStore Classic computer independent
claimAssessment.correction: Current official AltServer documentation still requires AltServer on a computer over Wi-Fi/USB. Anisette assists account authentication and does not provide device installation transport.

claimAssessment.claim: SideStore refresh uses a local VPN
claimAssessment.correction: Current official instructions require LocalDevVPN for install/update/refresh; they also explicitly instruct refreshing SideStore itself.
The checked project uses Docker/AltServer-Linux and a running server; its current notes require an unlocked device on the same Wi-Fi.
Triggers do not supply installation permission or a guaranteed execution deadline.
Membership is annual; material expiry/revocation and reinstall still matter. TestFlight builds have a separate maximum 90-day testing window and applicable review.

claimAssessment.claim: historical jailbreak tools work on every current device
claimAssessment.correction: Privileged jailbreak routes are a different scenario; exact iOS/tool compatibility must be checked separately.

orderedAcceptanceGates.passEvidence: Apply the two exact test call fixes and run one coherent SDK/Native selection after the pending batch is composed. Compilation success alone grants no renewal acceptance.

On the intended device under explicitly recorded conditions, bind service protocol, pairing identity, authenticated transport and installation Lookup. If this fails, keep strict standalone renewal unaccepted and do not request another generic TCP-only test.
A real authorized account yields same-team/same-identity profiles with later expiration for all application components. Preserve certificate/private-key association and handle quotas.
Sign the full original-JVM application and all nested code, independently verify CMS, CodeDirectory, resources, entitlements and archive. Retain before/after digests.
Actual same-identity overwrite, new-process observation of the later installed expiry, and preserved books/sources/reading progress. Upgrade ACK and bundle/version Lookup alone cannot pass.
Repeated actual foreground/system-granted background cycles plus interruption/restart/retry evidence; explicitly identify external recovery after the app becomes non-launchable.
